title: Programmatic detector Score for recall evaluations
description:
Purpose: Add a Python Score subclass (not Tactus) that detector-style evaluations can name in YAML class. Register it in plexus.scores.resolve_score_class. predict() is just-in-time scan plus lookup; Yes/No detected.

This epic is Plexus registry and Score ABC work. Scanner invocation details live on the calling product board. Parked under the local-first initiative because that is the runtime this score is meant to hit first.

Do not start until the local store and scorecard plan are massaged.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Board repair: parent plx-3f0d4750-f6d3-4867-a3ef-36aad4f0d800 was referenced since this epic was created (f27efe07e) but never existed in git history on any branch, which broke kbs validate. Re-pointed to plx-765ff010 (File-backed local GraphQL storage), the only local-first initiative, created 21s before this epic and matching its description ('parked under the local-first initiative').

right_now_summary: A programmatic detector Score now runs from YAML and is registered in Plexus.
